summary: Added a frontend, a first-run setup wizard, and database-backed runtime settings for the proposed mypintusan (physical access control) app, previously API-only. A new React SPA (apps/mypintusan/views/react-webpack/, building to apps/mypintusan/static/) scaffolded from myidsan's SPA onto the shared frontend/shared (@shared) module covers Doors (cards, remote unlock, lockdown), People (holders + badge issue/revoke), Activity (the access log), Readers, and Settings; apps/mypintusan/app/app.go gained RegisterWebRoutes to serve the SPA shell. src/views/Wizard.js is the first-run wizard (welcome -> site/timezone -> reader cable -> door -> first person + badge -> done), gated on GET /api/setup/state and user.isAdmin. Its door step is the first caller of a new POST /api/doors (apps/mypintusan/apis/doors.go), which creates a door and its entry reader in one call, rolling the door back if the reader insert fails, so a door and reader are never left half-configured. config.json's access/buses block is now a first-boot seed only: a new services/runtime_settings.go (AccessSettings, ported from mymatasan's runtime-settings pattern at the user's direction) persists timezone/tick/PIN-window/offline and the bus/reader/SCBK inventory in the shared runtime_setting table, exposed via a new GET/PUT /api/settings/access + POST /api/settings/access/reset (apps/mypintusan/apis/settings.go); the app boots by reading the live database row, not config.json, and refuses to start on a bad timezone the same way it always did. Driving the SPA live in a real browser (not just unit tests) found and fixed three bugs before this landed: the shared lib/api.js's apiRequest already JSON.stringifies the request body, and the app's own send() helper stringified it a second time, so every write in the SPA failed to unmarshal on the server; the first-run wizard renders instead of the app shell so ToastStack was never mounted while it was up, making every error inside it invisible until an inline error banner was added; and the shared DataTable's columns are {key, label, render} with render(value, row), not title/render(row), and getting that wrong crashed and unmounted the whole app mid-session. docs/MYPINTUSAN_DATA_MODEL.md, README.md and docs/TECHNICAL_SPEC.md are updated to drop the now-stale 'API only, no frontend' framing, and the relevant docs/modules/apps/mypintusan/**.go.md files are updated or added to match.
compatibility: mypintusan remains unshipped and out of the release/version-bump pipeline: it still has no infra/versioning/version.json app manifest entry, so this stays scoped 'infra' per this repo's version-bump rule (an app-named changelog scope hard-errors in infra/versioning/bump.go until that entry exists), and nothing outside a developer running `go run . -app mypintusan` or `cmd/mypintusan` is affected. For anyone who already has a mypintusan instance running from config.json alone, the access/buses block in config.json is read exactly once more, on the first boot after this change, to seed the runtime_setting row; every boot after that reads the database and config.json edits are silently ignored going forward, matching mymatasan's existing settings pattern. There is still no groups/schedules/grants UI or API (door assignment still needs direct database access), no reader onboarding beyond the wizard's single reader (no bus discovery, no SCBK rekey from the UI), no serial bus transport, no myiotsan door-contact/relay bindings, and no myseliasan fleet adoption.
